<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Arts and culture
*[[Mercury Prize]]
**The band [[Wolf Alice]] wins the 2018 [[Hyundai Motor Company|Hyundai]] [[Mercury Prize]] for its album ''[[Visions of a Life]]''. [https://www.theguardian.com/music/2018/sep/20/mercury-prize-2018-won-by-wolf-alice-visions-of-a-life (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Storm Bronagh]]
**Bronagh, the second named storm of the [[2018–19 European windstorm season]], begins moving across [[Ireland]] and the [[United Kingdom]]. [http://www.itv.com/news/2018-09-20/storm-bronagh-set-to-bring-gusts-of-up-to-70mph-in-aftermath-of-ali/ (ITV)]
**Heavy rainfall from Bronagh results in severe [[flash flood]]s across northern [[England]]. [[Sheffield]] is the worst affected city, with dozens of vehicles becoming stranded in rising floodwaters during the evening rush hour. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-45588463 (BBC)]
**High winds from Bronagh arrive later in the day, gusting up to {{convert|97|kph|mph}} in parts of [[Wales]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-45588463 (BBC)]
*[[MV Nyerere sinking|MV ''Nyerere'' sinking]]
**At least 136 people are dead and more than 100 others are missing after a ferry capsizes in [[Lake Victoria]], [[Tanzania]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-45599042 (BBC)]
*[[2018 Naga, Cebu landslide]]
**At least 25 people are killed and dozens are missing after a [[landslide]] unleashed by [[monsoon rains]] strikes [[Cebu]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.philstar.com/headlines/2018/09/21/1853425/22-dead-cebu-landslide-rescue-efforts-continue (''Philippine Star'')]
*[[2018 California wildfires]]
**The [[United States Forest Service]] says that the [[Mendocino Complex Fire]], largest wildfire on record in [[California]], has been contained. [https://www.mercurynews.com/2018/09/19/states-largest-wildfire-ever-now-fully-contained/ (''Mercury News'')]
*Eight people are killed in a head-on crash near [[Florence, Arizona|Florence]], [[Arizona]], [[United States]], after a car strikes an SUV. [https://www.abc15.com/news/region-central-southern-az/florence/dps-nine-killed-in-head-on-crash-near-florence (ABC15)]
*Four children from a day-care centre are killed in a collision involving a train and an electric cargo bike in [[Oss]], [[Netherlands]]. Another child and a woman are injured. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-45586492 (BBC)]
*A [[gas leak]] at the state archive in the city of [[Arezzo]], [[Italy]], kills two employees and injures one other. [http://www.ansa.it/english/news/general_news/2018/09/20/gas-leak-at-arezzo-archive-two-dead_fa08d971-7e0e-4a1d-9e05-4ab7100ff032.html (Ansa)]
*More than 30 passengers receive treatment after pilots forget to turn on a switch regulating cabin pressure on [[Jet Airways]] flight 9W 697 from [[Mumbai]] to [[Jaipur]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-45584300 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[Brexit negotiations]]
**At a [[European Union]] leaders' meeting in [[Salzburg]], [[European Council]] President [[Donald Tusk]] says that he will push for an additional gathering in mid-November, allowing the [[United Kingdom]]'s proposals to be "reworked and further negotiated". [https://www.dawn.com/news/1434012 (AFP via ''Dawn'')]
*[[September 2018 inter-Korean summit]], [[North Korea–South Korea relations]]	
**[[South Korea]]n [[President of South Korea|President]] [[Moon Jae-in]] states that [[North Korea]]n [[Supreme Leader of North Korea|leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]] wants to meet with [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] for a [[2018 North Korea–United States summit#Request for second North Korea–United States summit|second time]]. [https://www.npr.org/2018/09/20/649872652/kim-wants-new-summit-with-trump-moon-says-after-visiting-north-korea (NPR)]
*[[Doping in Russia]]
**The [[World Anti-Doping Agency]] votes to reinstate its affiliation with the [[Russian Anti-Doping Agency]], which had previously been suspended in November 2015. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/olympics/2018/09/20/olympics-wada-reinstates-russia-ends-suspension-after-doping-scandal/1365815002/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[Countering America's Adversaries Through Sanctions Act]]
**The [[United States State Department]] imposes sanctions on the [[Equipment Development Department of the Central Military Commission|Equipment Development Department]], an agency within the [[military of China]], for purchasing [[Sukhoi Su-35]] fighters and [[S-400 missile system]] equipment through [[Rosoboronexport]], [[Russia]]'s main arms export agency. [https://www.reuters.com/article/amp/idUSKCN1M02TP (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Aberdeen, Maryland shooting]]
**Three people are killed and three others are injured in a shooting at a [[Rite Aid]] distribution center in [[Aberdeen, Maryland]], USA. The suspected shooter then shoots and kills herself. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/09/20/us/maryland-shooting/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Japan]], [[Liberal Democratic Party (Japan) leadership election, 2018]]
**[[Japan]]ese [[Prime Minister of Japan|Prime Minister]] [[Shinzō Abe]] is elected for a third term as [[Liberal Democratic Party (Japan)#Presidents of the Liberal Democratic Party|President]] of the [[Liberal Democratic Party (Japan)|Liberal Democratic Party]]. [http://www.asahi.com/ajw/articles/AJ201809200058.html (''The Asahi Shimbun'')]

;Science and technology
*[[Climate of Mars]], [[Atmosphere of Mars]]
**The [[ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter]] reveals [[dust devil]]s in the [[Mars]] region [[Ariadnes Colles]]. New measurements indicate [[Human mission to Mars|astronauts traveling]] to Mars would experience 60% of their recommended career exposure to radioactivity in a single roundtrip journey. [https://cosmosmagazine.com/space/orbiter-reveals-martian-dust-devils-and-high-radiation-counts (''Cosmos Magazine'')] [https://www.iflscience.com/space/dust-devils-spotted-streaking-across-mars-surface-as-global-dust-storm-subsides/ (IFLScience)] 

;Sports
*[[2018 NFL season]]
**The [[Cleveland Browns]] win their first game in nearly two years after 635 days without a win. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2018/sep/20/cleveland-browns-new-york-jets-nfl-thursday-night-football (''The Guardian'')], [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/09/20/sports/cleveland-browns-win.html (''The New York Times'')]
